newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Sept Btp Liffe contract sets new high.
newsitem.headline: Italy Sept Btp Liffe contract sets new high.

text.p: The Italian September Btp Liffe contract set a new historic high above 137.05 just after the opening on Monday, touching 137.10, traders said.
The previous record of 137.05 was set on July 9 when the 10-year Btp/Bund narrowed to a record low 91 basis points.
At 0706 GMT, the Btp contract was 27 basis points firmer at 137.05. The Btp/Bund spread was 96 bps.
The lira was steadily firm versus the mark at 970.50/0.80 after an early high at 970.10.
